title: Answer to Question: The Dimensions of the Military Developments in Yemen
text:
Answer to Question: The Dimensions of the Military Developments in Yemen

Question:

[On Friday the chiefs of general staff of the armed forces of Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan met in the Saudi capital Riyadh within the framework of the Makkah Agreement for Joint Defence to discuss the security developments and the threats facing the Kingdom.. Al Jazeera, 2026/9/26]. This meeting remained silent until the Houthis took control of all or most of the western coast of Yemen without Saudi Arabia, or even America, intervening. Indeed, Trump declares that the Houthis promised not to attack American ships in the Red Sea, and that therefore America will not intervene! And so it was: for days the Houthis have been advancing on the western coast with ease. It was announced on 2026/9/11 that the Houthi group had completed its control of Bab al-Mandab; during an offensive of a few days, the group was able to take control of Hays, al-Khawkhah, al-Mukha and its port, reaching Bab al-Mandab and Mayun island.. So how did this happen with such ease? Why did Saudi Arabia and its tripartite alliance not intervene? And why did America not intervene, when it declares that it is against Iran's arms, and the Houthis are a main arm?! Indeed, America declares that it has communicated with the Houthi group directly, and the group admitted on 2026/9/20 its communication with America. So what is America's plan concerning this group linked to Iran?

Answer:

So that matters become clear as they truly are, we review the following matters:

1- The international conflict in Yemen has been raging since the beginning of the sixties of the last century. It is represented by the old colonialist of Yemen, Britain, and the new colonialist, America. Each colonialist has its regional and local tools. Britain's influence over Yemen was settled through its agents, headed by Ali Saleh, from 1978 until 2011... then Mansour Abd Rabbuh Hadi after him. Following that, America instructed its agent Saudi Arabia to intervene in Yemen, and Operation Decisive Storm was announced, together with the establishment of the so-called Coalition to Support Legitimacy led by Saudi Arabia, in 2015. But it was in reality to support the Houthi group. We mentioned in our publication dated 2015/3/26: (America supplied the Houthis, by way of Iran, with kinds of weapons and equipment so that they would be able to dominate Yemen by force, because it realises that the political milieu are in their majority the creations of the English.. Thus the Houthis thought that they had a power that would achieve for them domination over Yemen, so they besieged President “Hadi” to take from him what they wanted through the laws he issued. He would agree and then procrastinate in the implementation, until they imposed house arrest on him; he escaped from them to Aden, they pursued him, and he escaped from them a second time..).

2- Then it happened that the UAE, Britain's agent, infiltrated the mentioned coalition that Saudi Arabia established on the pretext of saving Yemen. It freed many areas in the south of Yemen from the grip of the Houthis and strengthened the influence of Britain and its local agents. It reached Hodeidah, the vital port of the Houthis, and almost took control of it, and it aimed to head to Sanaa after it. But America stirred up world public opinion against it on the pretexts of humanitarian aspects, and held the Sweden meeting, which decided on a ceasefire in the city of Hodeidah and the withdrawal by the UAE of its forces and its militias led by Tariq Saleh, and the security of the city remained in the hands of the Houthis. We mentioned in an Answer to Question we issued on 2018/12/20: (Britain knew that what holds up the backbone of the Houthis is the Iranian support, and after the closure of Sanaa airport and the control of the southern ports, the port of Hodeidah had become almost the only artery for Iran to deliver its support to the Houthis. Therefore the UAE headed to Hodeidah to take control of it, and the moves and battles around Hodeidah were met with great American rejection under humanitarian headings, and that the port of Hodeidah supplies Yemen with aid for millions of Yemenis, as if America had any regard for the humanity that it and its agents trampled in Syria under the feet of the United Nations, with the suffocating siege of cities and the barrel bombs... But it wanted to find justifications for the port of Hodeidah to remain open to the Iranian military support..).

3- In 2022 the formation of a Yemeni Presidential Leadership Council headed by Rashad al-Alimi was announced in Saudi Arabia on 2022/4/7, in place of President Hadi, as he handed his full powers to this council. Before that, on 2022/4/2, the warring parties had agreed to a truce in Yemen for a period of two months, extendable, which came into force in Yemen on 2022/4/2. The United Nations and the United States welcomed the surprise truce and called for its extension.. Although most of the council's members were former men of Britain, America, by way of Saudi Arabia, was able to win the head of the council, al-Alimi, to its side, although he had been among the followers of the English, as he held major political posts since the time of the former Yemeni president Ali Abdullah Saleh. But his residence in Saudi Arabia and his heavy dependence on what Saudi Arabia provides in aid, of financial and security support.. all of that gave Saudi Arabia a strong hold over him, which developed during the recent period.. As for the rest of the council's members, most of them were followers of the UAE, i.e. of the English.. So we said in an Answer to Question dated 2022/4/20: (It is noticed that all the members of the Presidential Leadership Council are among those backed by the UAE and from the group of President Hadi himself, so the effective opinion in the council is subordinate to Britain). Thus the truce, this decision and the formation of the council were all done by an American–British accord, and the agents and those revolving in the orbit follow this accord.. In all cases this accord is not permanent; rather it lasts only until the circumstances that called for this accord change!

4- And this is what happened. At the end of 2025 the forces of the Transitional Council in Yemen, led by Aidarous al-Zubaidi, whom the UAE backs and who is a member of the Presidential Council, proceeded to deploy his forces in Hadramawt and al-Mahra, and matters became greatly mixed up. The coalition led by Saudi Arabia in Yemen announced on 2025/12/30 the carrying out of a limited military operation targeting weapons and combat vehicles that had arrived from the UAE at the port of Mukalla in Hadramawt governorate. Then the threat continued until the UAE “submitted” and announced the withdrawal of its forces from Yemen, and Saudi Arabia continued threatening and warning the UAE's followers in Yemen (the Transitional Council led by Aidarous al-Zubaidi) to leave Hadramawt and al-Mahra, so the forces of the Southern Transitional Council in Yemen began to withdraw.. Then al-Zubaidi fled to Abu Dhabi, passing through Somaliland, and that was on 2026/1/8!

5- It appears that what happened recently on the western coast – i.e. what happened on the 3rd and 11th of September of this month, the Houthis' takeover of Hays, al-Khawkhah, al-Mukha and its port, Mayun island and the rest of the Yemeni islands in the south of the Red Sea, reaching Bab al-Mandab – resembles what happened in 2018, the expulsion of the UAE and its local followers from Hodeidah, and resembles what happened at the end of 2025 and the beginning of 2026, the expulsion of the UAE and its followers from Hadramawt and al-Mahra. I say that this resembles that, for in the Houthi operation America wanted to strike Britain's influence in Yemen by striking its agents on the western coast. There was what was called “the National Resistance with the core of the Republican Guard”, led by Tariq Saleh, which the UAE sponsored and guarded by order of its master Britain, which ended with the fall of al-Mukha and Camp Khalid on the shore of the Red Sea and the completion of the Houthi group's control over all of its shores. The fall of al-Mukha on 2026/9/10 dealt a strong blow to the commander of this resistance, Tariq Saleh, the agent of the English and the nephew of the former president Ali Saleh, Britain's agent, whom the UAE backs. It was another step in liquidating Britain's agents, after its other agent Aidarous al-Zubaidi had been defeated and forced to flee to the UAE. Reflecting on this step, it is most likely that Saudi Arabia was able to insert its agents into the Republican Guard, and they withdrew from their positions in their areas on the western coast on orders from Saudi Arabia.. This confused the forces of the English in the Guard led by Tariq Saleh, which forced him to order his forces to withdraw from all positions in the city, after he was subjected, as appeared in the audio recordings published on internet pages, to what he described as “betrayals from within”, meaning Saudi Arabia's wings in the Guard, and to what he described as “being let down by the brothers”, meaning by it Saudi Arabia itself, which did not move to support him and to strike the Houthis' movements. After all that, the Houthis entered these areas without resistance, just as they entered Sanaa previously without resistance!

6- What confirms that is that Saudi Arabia did not act and activate the joint tripartite alliance by asking its partners in this alliance, Pakistan and Turkey, to intervene, which confirms that it is complicit and does not want to undertake serious action against the Houthis. This is because America, which was behind the founding of this alliance, did not ask for its activation and for intervention against the Houthis, while they are targeting areas in Saudi Arabia! Turkey and Pakistan sufficed with condemnations and non-serious statements that they are ready to help. Indeed, Ibn Salman did not turn to them and did not direct any appeal to them, and waited until all or most of the western coast of Yemen was in the hands of the Houthis, and then called the Makkah alliance to a meeting to look into helping Saudi Arabia against the Houthis' attacks! [On Friday the chiefs of general staff of the armed forces of Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan met in the Saudi capital Riyadh within the framework of the Makkah Agreement for Joint Defence to discuss the security developments and the threats facing the Kingdom.. The Saudi Ministry of Defence said that the meeting dealt with strengthening intelligence and military cooperation and the integration of capabilities in a way that contributes to strengthening deterrence and collective defence.. According to the ministry, the chiefs of general staff reviewed the security situation and also condemned the attacks that targeted Makkah al-Mukarramah and the civilian infrastructure in the Kingdom, and the parties to the agreement strongly affirmed their commitment to collective defence, in a way that embodies the determination of the three states to defend the security, sovereignty and territorial integrity of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.. Al Jazeera, 2026/9/26]. That is, it is a meeting that took place after the Houthis had come to tighten their control over the western coast of Yemen!

7- Then America did not intervene and did not strike the Houthis, while it repeatedly declares that it strikes Iran's arms. It did not ask Saudi Arabia to strike them and did not ask it to activate the tripartite alliance, although with Iran's other arms it took severe measures in Syria, Iraq and Lebanon. And although the Houthis are a strong arm of Iran in Yemen, America and Saudi Arabia did not take a decisive measure as they do with Iran's other arms; they did not move to prevent the Houthis from taking control of the western coast of Yemen! Their complicity in this matter is clear to everyone who has two eyes. Reuters on 2026/9/13 reported three sources as saying (“.. and that the American President Trump made a phone call with the Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed Salman”, describing him as “a good friend of mine, and I can only say that everything will be fine and in the best state”). This means that Trump is behind this complicity, because everything will be fine and in the best state, i.e. as America wants, and the result will be in its favour! What confirms that is the visit of the American Secretary of State Marco Rubio to Saudi Arabia and his meeting with its ruler Ibn Salman during the Houthis' advance on the western coast, and his statement on 2026/9/8: (America enjoys very strong military defence relations with Saudi Arabia. And we are watching those events closely). So the American official declares that America is watching the events closely, i.e. that it knows of everything that is happening!

8- In confirmation of that also, America refused the request of the government of Yemen for military intervention. Reuters on 2026/9/21 reported a Yemeni source and another Western one as saying that (Rashad al-Alimi, head of the Yemeni Leadership Council, asked Trump during a phone call yesterday for American military assistance, and the sources mentioned that Trump did not make any direct pledge to provide military support during the call). Likewise Trump declares, saying: (“The Houthis have contacted us, and they do not want to fight with us, and they much prefer that we do not intervene, and they are allowing most ships to pass”... Al-Araby Al-Jadeed, 2026/9/13). Reuters on 2026/9/16 reported five sources as saying that (“American officials held a secret meeting with representatives of the Yemeni Houthi group inside the American embassy in Muscat during the weekend. Prominent Houthi officials took part in the talks, among them the group's spokesman Mohammed Abdulsalam, who is subject to American sanctions, and Abdulmalik al-Ajri”. These sources said “that the Houthi representatives pledged during the meeting to abide by the ceasefire agreement concluded with Washington in 2025 and not to target American or Israeli ships, but they reserved the right to attack hostile ships”). Mohammed al-Bukhaiti, a member of the political bureau of the Houthi group, admitted on 2026/9/20, in an interview via the Zoom application with the American Associated Press agency from Sanaa, (that indirect contacts took place between his group and America by way of the Sultanate of Oman, and that the group informed President Trump's administration that it does not intend to target America or its ships in the Red Sea and the Bab al-Mandab strait, and that its current operation is directed against Saudi Arabia; and that Washington communicated with the group during the advance of its forces on the western coast of Yemen and their arrival at areas overlooking the Bab al-Mandab strait). All of that indicates that what happened is of America's planning, and that the Houthi group proceeded in this plan knowingly!

9- Reflecting on the Houthi attacks that have taken place and are taking place on the western coast of Yemen, and on the fact that the Houthis are almost closing in on the whole coast, and yet America does not move to rescue the Yemeni government in Aden, nor does Saudi Arabia move either, although the Houthis' attacks have struck it as well; this in addition to the meetings of the Houthis' representatives with the Americans in Muscat, the capital of Oman, and the statements referred to above about America not intervening to repel the Houthis' attacks on the western coast despite the request of the Aden government; all of this indicates that the Houthi occupation of most of the western coast of Yemen is with American and Saudi approval, and it appears that it does not go beyond the following three aims:

The first: Involving the Houthis in the rule of Yemen, and that they have the basic role in rule, and then gradually excluding the agents of the English in Yemen from rule, especially since the followers of the English in Yemen have not all been eliminated; rather some of them are in the Presidential Council and around it.

The second: That this matter is a means of enticement for the rulers in Iran and a preparation for the softening of their position towards America, as appeared in the American–Iranian meetings in New York, and likewise from the presentation of the Iranian plan, which the President of Iran and the Iranian Foreign Ministry presented and which they expected Trump to approve so that Iran would return to revolving in the orbit. But Trump, in his arrogance, rejected it, because he still insists that Iran be only a subordinate agent...

The third: It is by way of the warrior's rest, as America faces midterm elections in about a month, and the electoral process requires calming situations, especially the military conflict, until the end of the elections..

It appears that these three aims, singly or combined, are behind the absence of an effective response from America and Saudi Arabia to the Houthis' takeover of the western coast of Yemen, and so the Houthis were enabled to take control of the western coast with ease and smoothness!

10- Thus we see the Anglo-American conflict raging in Yemen, but with regional and local tools. Its people are fuel for this conflict and have suffered bitterly from this conflict for decades. These tools do not care about the people as much as they care about their personal interests. Therefore there is no salvation for Yemen except by getting rid of these tools, which enable the conflicting colonial states to remain and to extend their influence. This is not achieved except by establishing the Rightly Guided Khilafah on the method of the Prophethood, which Allah promised: “Allah has promised those among you who believe and do righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] in the land”, and of which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave glad tidings: “Then there will be a Khilafah on the method of the Prophethood”, extracted by Ahmad, at-Tayalisi and al-Bazzar. Therefore we call upon the people of Yemen, whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praised with his saying: “Iman is Yamani, here” (extracted by al-Bukhari), and with his saying ﷺ: “Fiqh is Yamani and wisdom is Yamaniyyah” (extracted by al-Bukhari and Muslim); we call upon them to give us their Nusrah in Hizb ut-Tahrir, so that we all work together to realise the promise of Allah, the Strong, the Mighty, and the glad tidings of His Messenger ﷺ, and so succeed in the two abodes, and that is the great success.

On the fifteenth of Rabi' al-Akhir 1448 AH

2026/9/27 CE
